name: Tripura Risa Textile
summary: Tripura Risa Textile or Risa Textile is a traditional handwoven cloth from Tripura, India, recently granted a Geographical Indication (GI) tag.
description: Tripura Risa Textile or Risa Textile is a traditional handwoven cloth from Tripura, India, recently granted a Geographical Indication (GI) tag.
culturalContext: Registered as a Geographical Indication of India (handicraft, Tripura; registration 2023–24), which protects the name for products made in its place of origin by traditional methods.

visualDNA.Overview: It is primarily woven by women using a loin loom, Risa is known for its vibrant colors and intricate designs. It holds significant cultural and social value within the Tripuri communities, serving as a female upper garment, headgear, stole, and a symbol of respect. The Risa Sormani ceremony, where adolescent girls receive their first Risa, marks a significant transition. The GI tag protects the unique origin and craftsmanship of Tripura Risa Textile, promoting its preservation and sustainable development.
